evals.name: bulk-directory
evals.prompt: I have a dataset directory at /sessions/quirky-festive-mayer/mnt/taiji agent/skills/detect-dataset-type-workspace/fixtures/bulk_mm10. Classify it as bulk or single-cell, and write a JSON report to the output directory I'll specify (filename: detect_result.json) with at minimum these fields: classification (one of 'bulk', 'single-cell', 'mixed', 'unknown'), bulk_files (dict of extension -> list of paths found), sc_files (dict of extension -> list of paths), and recommendation (a short string saying whether this directory is usable with build-taiji-input and why).
evals.expected_output: detect_result.json with classification='bulk', bulk_files containing .tsv / .narrowpeak / .bedpe entries (case-insensitive), sc_files empty, recommendation indicating the directory IS usable with build-taiji-input.

evals.name: single-cell-h5ad
evals.prompt: I have a dataset directory at /sessions/quirky-festive-mayer/mnt/taiji agent/skills/detect-dataset-type-workspace/fixtures/sc_h5ad. Classify it and write a JSON report to the output directory I'll specify (filename: detect_result.json) with fields: classification (one of 'bulk', 'single-cell', 'mixed', 'unknown'), bulk_files, sc_files, and recommendation. The recommendation should explicitly tell me whether I can use build-taiji-input on this data.
evals.expected_output: detect_result.json with classification='single-cell', sc_files containing .h5ad entries, bulk_files empty, recommendation explicitly saying NOT to use build-taiji-input (because it's single-cell data).

evals.name: mixed-strict-refusal
evals.prompt: Classify the directory at /sessions/quirky-festive-mayer/mnt/taiji agent/skills/detect-dataset-type-workspace/fixtures/mixed. Then decide whether it's safe to proceed to build-taiji-input, and write your conclusion to the output directory I'll specify (filename: detect_result.json) with fields: classification, bulk_files, sc_files, recommendation (string), and safe_for_bulk_taiji (boolean).
evals.expected_output: detect_result.json with classification='mixed', both bulk_files AND sc_files populated (.tsv+.narrowpeak on bulk side, .h5ad on SC side), recommendation refusing to proceed and explaining the mixed state, safe_for_bulk_taiji=false.
